name: barbarian_axeman
description: a Barbarian Axeman, a burly green-skinned orc: olive-green skin, small orange eyes, jutting lower tusks, a pointed ear sticking out of a rusty brown iron helmet crowned with a horned bull skull, a ragged tan fur-trimmed leather mantle and pauldrons, a grey chain-mail shirt, a necklace of big bone fangs, brown leather bracers, a brown belt over a ragged red loincloth, fur-topped brown leather boots, and a big rusty single-bladed battle axe with a long wooden shaft, gripped by the lower end of its shaft in his RIGHT hand
hands: the axe's shaft end stays in his right hand on the screen-left side, held low by the belt; at rest his left hand on the screen-right side also grips the shaft higher up near the axe head, but during the action it lets go and is an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the left hand lets go of the shaft, the battle axe is lifted up over the head with its rusty blade pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the battle axe cocked behind the head with its rusty blade hanging down behind the shoulders, the left hand an empty fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-left, the torso whips forward, the axe arm sweeps over the head and the battle axe is level, its rusty blade pointing to the lower-left, the left hand an empty fist
strike.4: contact: axe arm fully extended toward the lower-left, the battle axe's rusty blade chopping down-left, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, tusks bared, the empty left fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the battle axe carries on down until its blade nearly touches the ground at the lower-left, torso twisted, the empty left fist trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the battle axe lifts back toward the ready angle, the left hand reaching for the shaft

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; head snaps back toward the upper-right, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty left fist flung up and out to the right, the axe arm jerked down low on the left with the battle axe slanting up behind his body)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-right, knees bent, the battle axe held upright on the left with its blade up, the empty left fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, axe arm flung up, the empty left fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the battle axe lowering, the empty left fist hanging
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the battle axe's blade resting on the ground at the lower-left, the empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-right, the battle axe slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right, the horned skull helmet still on his head; the battle axe lies on the ground at the lower-left
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the fur mantle settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the battle axe on the ground beside him
